stock.description: Kiddieland International Limited functions as an investment holding entity, primarily engaged in the development, manufacturing, and global sales of plastic toys and laboratory equipment. Its market reach extends across the United States, Europe, the Asia Pacific and Oceania regions, and Africa. The company's operations are divided into two main segments: the Toy Business and the Laboratory Equipment Business. The Toy Business segment encompasses an Outdoor-and-Sports category, which produces and supplies items such as ride-ons, rockers, trikes, scooters, and walkers. It also includes an Infant-and-Preschool Toy category, focusing on interactive playsets, activity toys, musical toys, and action vehicles. The Laboratory Equipment Business segment specializes in the creation, production, and distribution of scientific apparatus for primary and secondary educational institutions, along with a score evaluation system. Beyond these core activities, the company provides design services for various graphic requirements in toy production, offers management services, merchandises materials for toy manufacturing, and handles the import and distribution of toy products. Founded in 1998, Kiddieland International Limited is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of KLH Capital Limited.
